title: Internal SOP Knowledge Base with AI Search
summary: A Notion-style document system for SOPs with folders, version history, a recycle bin, roles, and automatic embeddings so every document is searchable by meaning.
headline: A company knowledge base you can actually search
seoTitle: SOP Knowledge Base with AI Search
problem: The team's SOPs lived in scattered documents that were hard to search, with no history of changes, and nothing ready to power an AI assistant.
solution: I built a full-stack rich-content editor with nested folders, media embedding, auto-save, role-based access and a recycle bin. Every save triggers an n8n workflow that creates or refreshes the document's embeddings, and deleting a document removes them, so AI search never goes stale.
highlights: Rich text editor with images, videos and links
Recycle bin with a retention window
Supabase auth, role-based permissions and row-level security
Automatic embedding create, update and delete through n8n
role: Sole engineer. I built the frontend, the database and permissions, and the embedding workflows, and set it up as the knowledge source for an AI chatbot.

results.label: A single source of truth for company procedures
Every document instantly searchable by meaning, not just keywords
Foundation in place for an internal AI assistant
